name: Davidson County, TN
findings: Davidson County has 3,108 nonprofit organizations. 1,337 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,060 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Davidson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 35 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 15 in similar places of this size.
